units.source_text: 白天，夏日还恋恋不舍驻足不前，沙子晒焦了，

en.t: By day, the summer heat still lingered unwilling to leave, and the sand was scorched,

units.source_text: 赤着脚走五分钟都忍受不了，

en.t: so unbearable that one could not walk barefoot for even five minutes,

units.source_text: 但太阳一西沉，屋子里透风的四壁，到底让人感到了阵阵凉意，

en.t: but once the sun sank westward, the drafty walls of the house finally made him feel waves of coolness,

units.source_text: 他还得硬着头皮去把潮湿的炉灰晒干。

en.t: and he still had to force himself to go dry the damp stove ashes in the sun.

units.source_text: 因这气温的变化，没有风的早晨，雾就像浑浊的河流一般。

en.t: Because of this change in temperature, on windless mornings the fog was like a muddy river.
